steps.title: Choose Proposal
steps.body: From any home page, click + ADD at the bottom of the screen and pick Proposal.
steps.note: Proposals go out BEFORE a quote or job exists — they're for giving the customer options to choose from, based on a conversation you've already had.

steps.title: Set the basics
steps.body: Pick the Industry and Type (in shop or in field), then give the proposal a Title.
steps.note: The title is for you, not the customer — it's how you'll spot this one in a list of drafts.

steps.title: Pick the customer
steps.body: Click Select a customer, search by name, and tap to select. New customer? Use + ADD at the top of the search screen.

steps.title: Write your message
steps.body: The Comment is customer-facing. Your default language loads automatically — tweak it here with anything specific to this proposal.
steps.note: Set the default comment (links and embedded video work too) in Preferences > Proposal.

steps.title: Expiration and documents
steps.body: Set an Expires On date, then check any Documents that should ride along — service agreements, waivers, T&Cs.

steps.title: Name your first offer
steps.body: Give Offer #1 a title your customer instantly gets — think Good, Better, Best. Then attach the vehicle with Select vehicle(s).

steps.title: Add the services
steps.body: Click Select products/services and build the offer. Chips show pricing by vehicle type — tap the one that matches, here Coupe $2,000.

steps.title: Duplicate the offer
steps.body: Here's the time-saver: instead of building the next offer from scratch, click DUPLICATE. Everything copies over — including add-ons.

steps.title: Differentiate offer two
steps.body: Retitle the copy — Better - Level 5 Ceramic Package — and swap or adjust the services that make it the step up. Repeat for as many offers as you want.

steps.title: Draft or send
steps.body: Click the green check and choose: SEND it now, or save as a DRAFT to send later.
steps.note: Pro move: build your standard offerings once with a placeholder customer, save as Drafts, then Duplicate and swap in the real customer each time.

steps.title: Send by SMS or Email
steps.body: Pick the delivery channel and hit SEND. The toggle lets you hide per-item quantities and unit prices if you'd rather show one clean number per offer.

steps.title: Track it in Proposals
steps.body: Your proposal now sits in the Proposals tab as Pending — sent, but not acted on yet. Drafts, Finalized, Converted, Declined and Voided each get their own column.
steps.note: Need to change a pending proposal? You can't edit it — void it, duplicate, fix, and resend.

steps.title: They pick, you convert
steps.body: Your customer gets a Review and Select message, compares the offers with real totals — tax and fees included — and selects one. The proposal flips to Finalized, time-stamped, and one click on Convert to Job turns it into work on your calendar.
